thread_text:
kristin-peopleops: Quick idea  a 1-minute "Minute Goal Snapshot" managers and ICs can paste into 1:1s or Slack threads. Needs to be ultra-short so folks will actually use it. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar-eng: Love the name. Make it 4 lines max: goal, one success metric, one blocker, one ask.

sasha-hrbp: Add a tiny "promo/evidence" line option for ICs prepping for calibration/promo packets. One short bullet.

li-manager: Also include two tiny example manager sentences (praise + quick redirect). Keep them actionable.

kristin-peopleops: Draft below  pasteable and directly usable in a 1:1 note or self-review.

---
`Minute Goal Snapshot (copyable)`
- Goal (1 line): [what + owner + due]
- Success (1 line): [metric -> target / baseline]
- Top blocker (1 line): [who/what can help]
- Manager ask (1 line): [one immediate ask for manager support]

Optional (promo evidence, 1 short bullet): [date  short result or link]

`Manager micro-lines (copyable)`
- Praise: "Nice work  that metric shift is clear and tied to user impact. Keep it up."
- Redirect: "I see the blocker X. Let's pick one mitigation this week and revisit in 7 days."
---

sasha-hrbp: This is great. For promo evidence note: ask ICs to paste 1 result + 1 stakeholder quote if available. Makes calibration easier.

omar-eng: Will use this for my 1:1s. Can we add a one-line timebox recommendation?

kristin-peopleops: Yup  add: "Timebox to 5 minutes in 1:1s; schedule deeper follow-up if needed." I'll add a Notion snippet and a Slack slash-snippet.

snippet-bot: Created snippet: /paste-minute-snapshot (enabled for managers).

li-manager: Quick Q  when should managers upload these to the calibration folder?

sasha-hrbp: Upload short snapshots (without full write-ups) 7 days before calibration opens. Save full write-ups only if requested.

kristin-peopleops: I'll schedule an automated reminder for managers 7 days before the window. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
